body: Drive turns inward as much as outward; the will is intense and self-directed, often used for self-mastery and depth rather than only external conquest. With nowhere to go, it can sit as simmering anger; given a channel, it becomes formidable focus.
business: Focused, formidable willpower that works on itself, not just the world.
shadow: Anger held in until it boils over, or force aimed at the self when the raw instinct is triggered.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Authored from supplied modern-point aspect file.
